Updated [frontier-27-batch-3.pages.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-27-batch-3.pages.json:1), [frontier-27-batch-3.coverage.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-27-batch-3.coverage.json:1), and [frontier-27-batch-3.notes.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-27-batch-3.notes.md:1). The scaffold now gives MT-15 a 35-item A page and 12-item B page, keeps the `L^infinity` exceptions explicit, makes the Borel-representative seam for convolution load-bearing, uses the explicit Euclidean cutoff route instead of importing general Urysohn as proof machinery, and adds the honest countable-generator lemmas needed for the general separability theorem.

Validation on Monday, August 31, 2026: `coverage-checklist` passed (`1` page, `45` harvested results), `content-policy --manifest-only` passed, `validate-plan` passed with only standing repo-wide `redundant-prereq` warnings, `source-fetch-check --stamp` passed (`4/4`), `git diff --check` passed, and JSON parsing was clean. `prosecheck` has only heuristic `count-in-prose` warnings. The only remaining blocker is `url-sweep`, which failed on all four exact hosts with shell-local DNS resolution errors; I recorded that in the notes and left the exact source records unchanged because those exact URLs were still re-opened and checked through the web reader on Monday, August 31, 2026.

Source stack verified against [Hunter](https://www.math.ucdavis.edu/~hunter/measure_theory/measure_notes.pdf), [Rudin](https://perso.telecom-paristech.fr/decreuse/_downloads/c22155fef582344beb326c1f44f437d2/rudin.pdf), [Wheeden–Zygmund](https://djvu.online/file/u1gYJemR8hzMe), and [Tao](https://terrytao.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/12/gsm-126-tao5-measure-book.pdf).
